title: Mass of a nonempty event
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $P$ be a predicate on $\Omega$, and suppose $P$ holds for at least one element of $\Omega$. Then the uniform probability of $P$ is at least $1/|\Omega|$.
hypotheses_covered: There exists a sample satisfying the predicate
